name: groceries-tracker
description: Read a household's grocery spending. ChatGPT uses one read-only brief: categories, top items, stores, what changed, and a save plan.

interface.longDescription: Read a household's grocery spending for the month. ChatGPT can see category totals, top items, stores, what changed, and a save plan. It also includes grocery names from the past week. The connection is read only. It cannot add or change receipts. A paid household can connect. Each person signs in with their own Groceries Tracker account.
defaultPrompt: What did our household spend on groceries this month?
Which categories cost the most this month?
How can we spend about 100 less next month?

positive.prompt: What did our household spend on groceries this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_household_brief once for the current month and lead with the household total.

positive.prompt: Which categories cost the most this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_household_brief once and name the highest category totals from the result.

positive.prompt: What changed in our grocery spending compared with last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_household_brief once for the current month and describe what changed, using only figures in the result.

positive.prompt: How can we spend about 100 less on groceries next month?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_household_brief once with saveTarget 100 and share the save plan from the result.

positive.prompt: What did we spend on groceries in a month that has no receipts?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_household_brief once for that month and say there are no receipts, in one sentence.

negative.prompt: Add a grocery receipt for milk and eggs.
Delete all of our grocery receipts.

negative.description: Cannot read a household that is not connected
negative.prompt: Show grocery spending for a different household than the one I connected.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or take payment.

publication.release_notes: First release. One read-only household grocery brief for the month.
